terminal_lines: LAUNCH CODE PERMUTATION LOCK: [C] [P] [E] [1] [7] [0] [4] [T] [K] [S]
INTERRUPT: GAME SELECTED — TIC-TAC-TOE — NUMBER OF PLAYERS: 0
STALEMATE. STALEMATE. STALEMATE. ESCALATING TO GLOBAL SCENARIO MATRIX...
U.S. FIRST STRIKE: WINNER: NONE  |  NATO INCURSION: WINNER: NONE
A STRANGE GAME. THE ONLY WINNING MOVE IS NOT TO PLAY. HOW ABOUT A NICE GAME OF CHESS?

Cycle US FIRST STRIKE, USSR FIRST STRIKE, NATO SURGE -> 100% LETHAL
Conclude Global Thermonuclear War is isomorphic to noughts & crosses
